authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-26: fresh 2v2 pole certification through the same certification logic as the other scales, no bypass; its output must be the handoff artifact every downstream 2v2 stage consumes. Do NOT count the original freeze-record poles, and do NOT auto-reuse the prior 2v2 strategic-demand certification.
THE_QUESTION: At 2v2, do the frozen poles demand OPPOSITE strategic responses from the scripted probes -- GUARD wins on Pole A and BREACH wins on Pole B?

SAME_LOGIC_AS_OTHER_SCALES.runner: experiments/certify_strategic_demand_scaled.py --team-size 2 (the one certification script; verified to contain no team-size branch)
SAME_LOGIC_AS_OTHER_SCALES.probes: scripted GUARD and BREACH from experiments/strategic_demand_searcher.py; GUARD defenders = ceil(N/2) = 1 at N=2 (equals the suite's k=1)
SAME_LOGIC_AS_OTHER_SCALES.pairing: GUARD and BREACH share each seed
SAME_LOGIC_AS_OTHER_SCALES.gate: CERTIFIED iff LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0; delta_A = WR(GUARD,A) - WR(BREACH,A), delta_B = WR(BREACH,B) - WR(GUARD,B)
SAME_LOGIC_AS_OTHER_SCALES.tie_or_reversal: writes a TIE_REVERSAL_AUDIT record before interpretation (built into the runner)

POLES_UNDER_TEST.source: the common size-normalized machinery, experiments/opponent_spec.py pole_A_genome(2) / pole_B_genome(2); no candidate genome override
POLES_UNDER_TEST.note_on_4v4: 4v4's certified Pole B is the B3-3 redesign (lock_defender=10, enable_2v1), adopted because canonical OP7 FAILED 4v4 certification. 6v6's certified Pole B is canonical OP7. 2v2 certifies canonical OP7 through the common machinery; if it fails, a pole redesign at 2v2 is a separate, explicitly authorized step -- never a silent substitution.

SEEDS.why_192: matches the 4v4 production certification (POLE_B3_3_N192) and the 3v3 N192 certification
SEEDS.allocated_via: experiments/seed_registry.py before any seed is spent

HANDOFF_ARTIFACT.output: STRATEGIC_DEMAND_2v2_CERTIFICATION.json (last entry of the trainer's governing precedence for 2v2, so it becomes the governing record)
HANDOFF_ARTIFACT.own_identity: the record's sha256 cannot live inside it; every consuming stage records it as pole_identity(...).certification_sha256
HANDOFF_ARTIFACT.consumption: downstream stages obtain poles only via pole_attestation.resolve_pole_genome -> certified_pole_genome, which refuses unless VERDICT is CERTIFIED and the rebuilt overlay equals the certified one
HANDOFF_ARTIFACT.round_trip_on_write: if CERTIFIED, the runner resolves both poles the way downstream stages will and requires the consumer pole_config_hash to equal the pinned one; it exits nonzero otherwise
HANDOFF_ARTIFACT.verified_before_freeze: tests/test_certification_pole_handoff.py drives the real writer at 2v2 in a temp directory with a deterministic episode runner (statistics genuinely implied by the rows): a genuine certification seals and hands off both poles; a genuine no-demand run seals NOT_CERTIFIED and is not consumable; faked statistics, a tampered row pole hash, a missing seed, a tampered handoff hash, a tampered pole overlay and a flipped verdict each land in AUDIT_FAILED; the pre-flight refuses before any episode on a missing or unfrozen spec, a missing experiment id, an unreserved block, or an existing output. Mutation check: removing the invariants lets the tampered handoff, tampered overlay and flipped verdict seal cleanly.

COST: about 26.5 s per seed on CPU (4 episodes), measured on the smoke; 192 seeds is about 85 minutes
AUTHORIZES_IF_CERTIFIED: the standardized 2v2 build per CROSS_SCALE_CANONICAL_RECIPE_V1.json: 1M anchor-off specialists -> entity repair -> split pi_D (k=1, N' teacher unchanged) -> Separated crossover -> standardized dataset -> distilled suite arms. Each of those still needs its own frozen spec and registered seed block.
IF_NOT_CERTIFIED: no canonical 2v2 experiment proceeds (the resolver refuses a NOT_CERTIFIED record). Next step is a PI decision, not an automatic redesign.
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: reusing the prior 2v2 strategic-demand certification or treating the freeze-record poles as certified
any Pole B candidate override at 2v2
any training or evaluation seed spend beyond this block
re-running into the same output (the runner refuses; certification is one-shot)

AMENDMENT_BEFORE_ANY_SEED.by: PI, 2026-09-26: seal the certification path before launching (Rule 7); this run is the root of trust for the standardized 2v2 pipeline. No seed of 23000001..23000192 had been spent when this section was added.
AMENDMENT_BEFORE_ANY_SEED.change: the certification record is written through experiments/run_state.seal, not with a hand-written status

SEALING_required.status_vs_verdict: 'status' (SEALED / AUDIT_FAILED) is owned by run_state.seal and says whether the result re-derives from the evidence on disk; 'VERDICT' (CERTIFIED / NOT_CERTIFIED) is the scientific result. Downstream consumption requires BOTH VERDICT=CERTIFIED and a SEALED record whose audit passed (pole_attestation.assert_certification_trustworthy).
SEALING_required.evidence: one CSV row per (seed, pole, style) episode, each carrying the genome_id and pole_config_hash of the pole it was run against

audit_verifies.registered_block_identity: seed_class sealed_confirmatory + experiment_id STRATEGIC_DEMAND_2V2_CERTIFICATION via seed_registry.check_block
audit_verifies.pole_identity_per_episode: derived::pole_config_hash and derived::genome_id against the pinned certified pole
audit_verifies.certification_statistics: claim::delta_A, claim::delta_B re-derived from the rows
audit_verifies.verdict: invariant::verdict_matches_evidence -- recomputed from the rows with the audit's bootstrap and compared with the VERDICT in the record being sealed
audit_verifies.handoff: invariant::handoff_matches_consumer_rebuild -- each pole rebuilt with the SAME function downstream consumption uses (pole_attestation.rebuild_certified_genome); its hash must equal the pinned row identity, the pole block and POLE_HANDOFF

SEALING_required.fail_closed: missing/malformed evidence, a raising invariant (including SystemExit-derived guards), or any failed gating check -> AUDIT_FAILED, recorded, and not consumable. Pre-flight (one-shot, frozen spec, experiment id, Rule-9 block) refuses BEFORE the first episode.
SEALING_required.lifecycle: RunState RUNNING -> COMPLETE -> AUDITED -> SEALED (or AUDIT_FAILED), begun before the first episode
SEALING_required.sealer_extension: run_state.AuditPlan.invariants -- a narrow, additive hook (empty by default; every existing sealer unchanged) for whole-row-set gating checks that no per-row derived rule can express
